quarterly_data.signal: Murphy sized the Teralynx switching franchise against its acquisition case: Innovium, bought five years ago, 'had no revenue, but was projected to do about $150 million of revenue. We now said that that business is on track to do $1 billion plus, and over the next years, we will probably grow even faster.' He said the Teralynx T100 part is already suitable for scale-up as is, with a suite of ESUN products coming and a parallel UALink investment because the market has not settled on a standard. Separately, he said connectivity 'this year is growing like 70% plus' and 'That growth rate’s going to roll over into next year as well.'
quarterly_data.figure: Innovium projected about $150 million at acquisition, now on track to do $1 billion plus; connectivity growing like 70% plus this year, rolling into next year
